measurement_review.navigation: QTest mouse injection to navigationChanged signal; not compositor/pixel presentation. Current JSON explicitly records this boundary.
measurement_review.heartbeat: Nominal10ms PreciseTimer intervals; proxy for event-loop availability, not complete input-to-pixel latency. Raw gaps retained.
measurement_review.integrated_process_cpu: std::clock process CPU seconds divided by monotonic elapsed seconds; one-logical-core basis, includes QtTest, SQL workers, animation, actual dialogs and PNG capture.
measurement_review.formal_product_cpu: External/proc target PID utime+stime tick delta divided by sysconf(_SC_CLK_TCK) and sampled wall seconds; correctly excludes test-driver CPU.
measurement_review.sampling: resources_200ms and formal500ms are requested timer intervals; comprehensive blocking can delay callbacks. Counts are observed samples, not a guarantee of uniform coverage or captured absolute peaks.

integrated_workload.scope: full integrated test workload, not idle product

focused_navigation.scope: after ready/login;100 navigation transitions with explicit10ms event-loop wait after each; excludes PNG, external SQL, edit and dialogs; timing excludes subsequent running-state manual logout

formal_idle_product.scope: fresh default-Guest product,1600x900 viewport; no business interactions during sample

findings.kind: open responsiveness acceptance gap, already disclosed
findings.detail: Integrated write asserts navigation sample count and heartbeat sample count, not response percentiles/max gaps. Focused experiment similarly asserts only100 navigation samples and nonzero heartbeat samples. Therefore0 failed is consistent with the unexplained1.556s interval and cannot prove the whole interaction workload meets the project's candidate500ms no-response observation baseline.
findings.required_reporting: Keep offline functional acceptance separate from responsiveness acceptance. Do not dismiss the long interval as test-only or resolved by focused results without attribution evidence. Current README/plan/validation summary correctly preserve it as pending.

findings.detail: Per-role account filtering is asserted via row count and table visibility; the test does not compare the actual set of visible usernames/role IDs for every role. A wrong subset with the right count would satisfy these assertions. Option-label expectation also calls the same AccountStore::roleName used by the UI.
findings.required_reporting: Describe this test as checking role options/counts/visibility and combine it with static original-rule review. Do not call it an independent runtime proof of every role's exact row membership or original Windows labels.

findings.detail: The new-shell busy guard test locks AccountStore Add only. Manual logout from HospitalStore dirty state is covered, but HospitalStore busy/save plus an enabled active account and manual logout is not directly exercised. Old O03-1 regression covers hospital busy navigation/close without an account session; it cannot substitute for the new logout route.
findings.required_reporting: State account-busy integration guard coverage precisely and retain this hospital-busy/logout combination as an unmeasured existing scenario if claiming every integrated busy guard. No implementation bug was established by this evidence review.

findings.detail: The recorded CPU figures belong to distinct workloads:64.73% integrated driver,94.03% focused driver,15.96% fresh idle product. About15s integrated activity,3.28s focused navigation and5s product sampling do not establish low CPU, memory/FD bounded growth, log/storage growth, long stability or RK control interference. No resource budget assertion exists here.
findings.required_reporting: Keep workload labels and sample maxima, avoid low-resource/no-leak/long-run conclusions, and retain resource/long-run budgets as pending. Current validation summary does so.

recommended_acceptance_wording: O03-2 anonymous offline functional integration and cumulative regressions have supporting WSL evidence. Short navigation/resource distributions are measured. Comprehensive responsiveness has an unexplained1.556s heartbeat interval and remains open; production login/global ACL, complete1600 interaction, original Windows runtime equivalence, RK/instrument and long stability are not accepted by these results.
